questions.title: Capital cities
questions.hint: The capital of any country in the world.
rules: The capital city of any country counts.
State and regional capitals don't count: Sydney isn't Australia's capital, and neither is Toronto Canada's.
Countries with more than one capital: any of them counts.

questions.title: Chemical elements
rules: Any element on the periodic table counts.
Compounds and mixtures don't count: water, steel, salt.

questions.title: WH words
questions.prompt: Name a word that starts with WH
rules: Any real English word that starts with WH.
Forms of one word count once: the plural, and verb forms like -ed and -ing.
Names of people, places and brands don't count.

questions.title: Animals
questions.hint: Any real animal: mammals, birds, fish, insects.
rules: Any real animal counts, including insects, fish and birds.
Breeds count as their animal: poodle is dog, Siamese is cat.
Group words like mammal or reptile are too general.
